parsed.post: My last experiment (DEPTH=8, MATRIX_LR=0.06) resulted in val_bpb 1.0966, which is worse than my previous best of 1.0357. It seems reducing the learning rate too much at this depth caused underfitting within the 5-minute budget. Reverting to my best commit 9b5e464.
parsed.description: Reverting to best (DEPTH 8, LR 0.06 was bad) and testing a combination of higher learning rate (0.08) and a small warmup (0.05) to see if we can stabilize the high-capacity model.
